BL-1603 — record-review-evidence.js takes its root from process.cwd(), so a role that runs it from extension/ (where npm must run) writes and commits a correct evidence file under extension/backlog/evidence/ that no repo-root grep or bounce-history read ever sees - six such files are on main (cleaner x4, hardender x1, QA x1), five with no repo-root copy; the writer resolves the repository root itself, refuses to write anywhere but <root>/backlog/evidence/, the orphans move to where they belong, and a test with the working directory stubbed to a subdirectory proves it
What it solves: ## What is wrong
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM: the writer's root is the repository top level of the directory it runs in (git rev-parse --show-toplevel through an injected cwd, never process.chdir), and it refuses with a named reaso…
BL-1603 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1603" (or "reject BL-1603 <reason>") to act.
